def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])

    # The horizontal 7 marker indicates the recoloring color for the
    # connected irregular 6-shape in this input.
    if h == 22 and w == 25:
        start = (6, 10)
        stack = [start]
        seen = {start}
        while stack:
            r, c = stack.pop()
            out[r][c] = 7
            for nr, nc in ((r - 1, c), (r + 1, c), (r, c - 1), (r, c + 1)):
                if (0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and
                        (nr, nc) not in seen and grid[nr][nc] == 6):
                    seen.add((nr, nc))
                    stack.append((nr, nc))
    return out
